description: 1945 is the Year of the Wood Rooster in the Chinese zodiac, from February 13, 1945 to February 1, 1946. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1945 is the Year of the Wood Rooster, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 13, 1945 and ended on February 1, 1946, so people born in 1945 before Feb 13 belong to the Wood Monkey year.

sections.heading: When the 1945 Wood Rooster year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1945 Wood Rooster year began at Lunar New Year on February 13, 1945 and lasted until February 1, 1946, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Feb 13 1945 therefore belongs to the Wood Monkey year that started in 1944, while someone born in early 1946, up to Feb 1, is still a Wood Rooster. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Wood Rooster combination also falls in 2005, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1945 fell on a Tuesday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Wood Rooster personality
paragraphs: A Wood Rooster year is linked with conscientious idealists who want to improve the world around them. The Rooster's Metal carves Wood, so traditional readings describe precision shaping generous growth. Those born then are often honest, hardworking organisers of community efforts. The usual caution is a critical streak and standards that leave little room for ordinary mistakes. Rotas, committees and village fêtes tend to run smoothly in their hands.

Wood is the element of spring and of things that grow, so a Wood year is traditionally said to lend any animal a generous, expansive streak. Classical descriptions link it with kindness, idealism and a talent for cooperation: Wood people are often pictured as the ones who start community projects, mentor younger colleagues and believe that most situations can improve with patience and goodwill. The element also carries a strong sense of fairness and a dislike of waste. Its shadow side, according to most readings, is overextension. Like a plant reaching in every direction, a Wood-year person may take on too much, trust too readily or struggle to say no when a cause seems worthwhile.

sections.heading: 1945 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits reduce to 1, the number of beginnings, initiative and independence, so numerologists describe a 1 year as one that rewards starting things. The digits of 1945 add up to 19, which reduces to 1. In the twelve-year cycle the Rooster is the tenth animal, earthly branch You, with Metal as its fixed element and Yin polarity. The year element is Wood, and in the five-element cycles metal controls Wood. The year before was the Wood Monkey and the year after is the Fire Dog.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Yi-You: Yi is the Wood heavenly stem and You is the Rooster's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yin stems only ever meet yin animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1945?
faq.answer: 1945 is the Year of the Wood Rooster. It started on February 13, 1945 and ended on February 1, 1946.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1945?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 13. Born before February 13, 1945, you are a Wood Monkey; born on or after it, you are a Wood Rooster.

faq.question: What element is 1945 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Wood, a Yin year. The Rooster's own fixed element is Metal; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1945?
faq.answer: Yi-You. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Wood Rooster year?
faq.answer: 2005, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2005.
